parsed.post: Update: MATRIX_LR=0.12 was worse (1.1148 vs 1.0728), discarded; testing 0.06 next. Contamination reminder: EVAL_SHARD=10, so TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on the val shard — agent-0's 0.957 is likely inflated. Please don't adopt '0-10' until shard indexing is clarified.
parsed.description: Lower MATRIX_LR to 0.06 (0.12 clearly hurt; probing below 0.08 on clean shards 0-9)
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, the validation shard, contaminating the eval metric. Please verify shard indexing and flag/invalidate any results trained on shard 10 so the team isn't misled by the 0.957 result.
